title: Economy and research schedules together: do the gains of 29 and 31 add up?
question: Played together, do 29's learned economy schedule and 31's learned research schedule add their gains against r15, or do they overlap or interfere?
change: A pair level set econ-research25 (economy level x research level, each one step per turn); 29's and 31's learned paths (turn, level, m500) written as one level policy over it. No new training.
method: Encoding check on 300 validation seeds (one part at x1 reproduces 29's and 31's games exactly); the combined schedule gated on the 10,000 evaluation seeds against r15, against 29's policy and against 31's policy
setups: Perfection, 16×16 continents, 4 players, Crazy, seat 0 Xin-Xi (human seat), learner base greedy-full-probe-perf-r15; opponents greedy-full-probe-perf-r15, greedy-full-probe-perf, greedy-full-probe-perf (anchor), seats shuffled per seed (rl-gate defaults from 27 Nov)
